scope: Test dense human geometry only. Mira reference images, LoRA, IP-Adapter, and inpainting were intentionally excluded.

inputs.guide: Pose Depot 2F_Hand_on_Hip/Depth.png; Apache-2.0 repository asset; used temporarily and not retained
inputs.guide_contract: High-angle, full-body, front three-quarter human depth with the head, torso, pelvis, legs, and feet all present.

runtime.pipeline: StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline with model CPU offload and VAE slicing

result.observed: With an adult, clothed prompt, the generated image retained one head, torso, pelvis, two legs, and two feet in a coherent high-angle three-quarter depth arrangement. The output is generic and photorealistic; its face, haircut, jacket construction, palette, and footwear do not satisfy the Mira character or watercolor style contracts.

decision: The density of the depth condition is sufficient to pass the anatomy-and-occlusion gate, but it is not a character-pack image and must not be used as final art. The candidate PNG, depth guide, checkpoint, and temporary runner were removed after review.
next_gate: Use the same class of human depth target only with one separately validated appearance condition. The next experiment must assess identity preservation independently; do not claim that this SD 1.5 result validates FLUX multiple-reference conditioning or a final webtoon cut.
